cc:Work.dc:title: Tray - GridfinityDrillBox
cc:Work.dc:description:
A Gridfinity box for drills or similar tools
You need to add a hole pattern to all horizontal layers except the very bottom
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes GridfinityDrillBox --nx 1 --ny 3 --sh 5:20:20:10 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes GridfinityDrillBox --nx --ny --sh --reference --labels
